Cached under the `products` key, so `useNuxtData('products')` reads them too. */ export function useProducts() { return useFetch('/api/products', { key: 'products', default: () => [] }) } import { useCookie } from '#app' import { computed } from 'vue' import { discountPercent } from '#shared/utils/discount' /** The active discount code, read from the `discount-code` cookie. */ export function useDiscount() { const code = useCookie('discount-code', { default: () => null }) const percent = computed(() => discountPercent(code.value)) return { code, percent } } import { formatMoney } from '~/utils/money' /** * Price after discount, as shown in the UI. * The discount is rounded down, so the UI never promises more than the server quote. */ export function applyDiscount(cents: number, percent: number): number { return cents - Math.floor(cents * percent / 100) } /** `399` -> `-$3.99`. */ export function formatDiscount(cents: number): string { return `-${formatMoney(cents)}` } /** `10` -> `10%`. */ export function formatPercent(percent: number): string { return `${percent}%` } /** `percent` of `cents`, rounded to the nearest cent. */ export function percentOf(cents: number, percent: number): number { return Math.round(cents * percent / 100) } export interface Product { slug: string name: string priceCents: number } export default defineNuxtConfig({ components: { dirs: [] }, }) export default defineNuxtConfig({ components: { dirs: [] }, }) /** Money format for the UI: `1999` -> `$19.99`. */ export function formatMoney(cents: number): string { return `$${(cents / 100).toFixed(2)}` }
